sentences.en: Shakespeare is the greatest poet that England has ever produced.
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚是英国历史上最伟大的诗人。

sentences.en: I can produce several pieces a day if I'm lucky.
sentences.zh: 如果我幸运的话，一天我可以生产出几件产品。

sentences.en: He produced a rabbit out of his hat by magic.
sentences.zh: 他用魔术从帽子里变出了一只兔子。

senses.zh: 生产，产生，展现，提出，引起，分娩，制片
